info.title: Loyal Spark — Onchain Loyalty Protocol on Base
info.summary: AI-agent-native loyalty-as-a-service protocol on Base L2 with paid x402 + MPP corridors.
info.description: Loyal Spark is an onchain loyalty-as-a-service protocol on Base L2. AI agents and merchants can create ERC-20 loyalty programs, mint tokens to customer wallets, manage reward catalogs, trade tokens on a P2P escrow marketplace, redeem rewards for vouchers, and run analytics — all via paid x402 endpoints (USDC on Base) or via standard REST with x-api-key. Coverage: 75 paid operations across 71 paths, including merchant REST (agent-api), recipient REST (recipient-api), 28 merchant MCP tools and 11 recipient MCP tools. Builder Code bc_wdmnog7m.
info.x-guidance:
Loyal Spark on Base L2 (chain 8453, USDC native).

Auth modes:
• Merchant agents — header x-api-key: lsk_... (or Authorization: Bearer lsk_...). Get a key in https://loyalspark.online/merchant → AI Agents.
• Holder agents — header x-api-key: rwk_... (or Authorization: Bearer rwk_...). Issued via SIWE: https://loyalspark.online/.well-known/agent.json.
• x402 corridor — pay USDC on Base per call. Discovery: https://loyalspark.online/.well-known/x402.

Typical merchant flow:
1. GET /me — profile and scopes
2. POST /programs — factory calldata to deploy ERC-20
3. POST /register-program — persist program
4. POST /update-program-config — set cashback_rate / points_per_dollar
5. POST /activate-program — unpause
6. POST /mint or POST /earn — distribute points
7. POST /rewards — catalog
8. GET /analytics — metrics

MCP mirrors REST: 28 merchant tools at https://bzxmejzssxjazswgwqqs.supabase.co/functions/v1/loyalty-mcp and 11 recipient tools at https://bzxmejzssxjazswgwqqs.supabase.co/functions/v1/recipient-loyalty-mcp. Each MCP tool also has a paid x402 path under /functions/v1/x402-gateway/mcp-tools/<name> and /functions/v1/x402-gateway/recipient-mcp-tools/<name>.

Docs: https://loyalspark.online/api-docs · llms: https://loyalspark.online/llms.txt · agent manifest: https://loyalspark.online/.well-known/agent.json
